text_es: Implement `categorize(books)`. The input is a list of book records, each containing a title string, a genre string, and a publication year integer. Group the book titles by their genre. Within each genre group, sort the titles alphabetically. The output must be a list containing two elements for each genre: the genre name and the sorted list of titles. For example, inputting a list with Dune in science fiction and Emma in romance will return a grouped structure isolating each genre and its books.
text_nat:
<?php

function validateBook($book)
{
    $required = ['title', 'genre', 'year'];
    foreach ($required as $field) {
        if (!array_key_exists($field, $book)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Book record is missing the '$field' field.");
        }
    }
    if (!is_string($book['title']) || trim($book['title']) === '') {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Book title must be a non-empty string.');
    }
    if (!is_string($book['genre']) || trim($book['genre']) === '') {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Book genre must be a non-empty string.');
    }
    if (!is_int($book['year'])) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Publication year must be an integer.');
    }
}

function categorize($books)
{
    $groups = [];
    foreach ($books as $book) {
        validateBook($book);
        $genre = trim($book['genre']);
        if (!isset($groups[$genre])) {
            $groups[$genre] = [];
        }
        $groups[$genre][] = trim($book['title']);
    }
    $result = [];
    foreach ($groups as $genre => $titles) {
        sort($titles, SORT_STRING);
        $result[] = [$genre, $titles];
    }
    return $result;
}

function earliestByGenre($books)
{
    $earliest = [];
    foreach ($books as $book) {
        validateBook($book);
        $genre = trim($book['genre']);
        if (!isset($earliest[$genre]) || $book['year'] < $earliest[$genre][1]) {
            $earliest[$genre] = [trim($book['title']), $book['year']];
        }
    }
    return $earliest;
}

function formatReport($books)
{
    $lines = [];
    $earliest = earliestByGenre($books);
    foreach (categorize($books) as $group) {
        list($genre, $titles) = $group;
        $lines[] = $genre . ': ' . implode(', ', $titles);
        $pioneer = $earliest[$genre];
        $lines[] = '  oldest: ' . $pioneer[0] . ' (' . $pioneer[1] . ')';
    }
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

$library = [
    ['title' => 'Dune', 'genre' => 'science fiction', 'year' => 1965],
    ['title' => 'Emma', 'genre' => 'romance', 'year' => 1815],
    ['title' => 'Neuromancer', 'genre' => 'science fiction', 'year' => 1984],
    ['title' => 'Persuasion', 'genre' => 'romance', 'year' => 1817],
    ['title' => 'Contact', 'genre' => 'science fiction', 'year' => 1985],
];

echo formatReport($library), PHP_EOL;
echo json_encode(categorize($library)), PHP_EOL;

text_es: Implement `recommend(network, user)`. The first input is an adjacency list representing friend connections, and the second is a target user name. Find all friends of the user's friends who are not already directly connected to the target user and are not the user themselves. Count how many mutual friends they share. Return a list of these recommended users along with their mutual friend count, ordered by the highest mutual count first.
text_nat:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Normalises an adjacency list so that every mentioned person has an entry
 * and no one is listed as their own friend or listed twice.
 */
function normaliseNetwork(array $network): array
{
    $clean = [];
    foreach ($network as $person => $friends) {
        if (!isset($clean[$person])) {
            $clean[$person] = [];
        }
        foreach ($friends as $friend) {
            if ($friend === $person) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!isset($clean[$friend])) {
                $clean[$friend] = [];
            }
            $clean[$person][$friend] = true;
            $clean[$friend][$person] = true;
        }
    }
    return array_map('array_keys', $clean);
}

/**
 * Friends-of-friends recommendations for $user, strongest connection first.
 * Each entry is [name, mutualFriendCount].
 */
function recommend(array $network, string $user): array
{
    $graph = normaliseNetwork($network);
    if (!isset($graph[$user])) {
        return [];
    }

    $direct = array_fill_keys($graph[$user], true);
    $mutual = [];
    foreach ($graph[$user] as $friend) {
        foreach ($graph[$friend] as $candidate) {
            if ($candidate === $user || isset($direct[$candidate])) {
                continue;
            }
            $mutual[$candidate] = ($mutual[$candidate] ?? 0) + 1;
        }
    }

    $ranked = [];
    foreach ($mutual as $name => $count) {
        $ranked[] = [$name, $count];
    }
    usort($ranked, static function (array $a, array $b): int {
        return $b[1] <=> $a[1] ?: strcmp($a[0], $b[0]);
    });
    return $ranked;
}

function formatRecommendations(string $user, array $ranked): string
{
    if ($ranked === []) {
        return "No recommendations for {$user}.";
    }
    $lines = ["Recommendations for {$user}:"];
    foreach ($ranked as [$name, $count]) {
        $plural = $count === 1 ? 'mutual friend' : 'mutual friends';
        $lines[] = sprintf('  %-8s %d %s', $name, $count, $plural);
    }
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

$network = [
    'Alice' => ['Bob', 'Carol'],
    'Bob' => ['Alice', 'Dave', 'Erin'],
    'Carol' => ['Alice', 'Dave', 'Frank'],
    'Dave' => ['Bob', 'Carol', 'Erin'],
    'Erin' => ['Bob', 'Dave'],
    'Frank' => ['Carol'],
];

foreach (['Alice', 'Frank', 'Zoe'] as $target) {
    echo formatRecommendations($target, recommend($network, $target)), PHP_EOL, PHP_EOL;
}

text_es: Implement `smooth(readings, window)`. The input is a list of sensor readings where each reading is a list containing a timestamp string and a numeric value. Calculate the simple moving average using the specified integer window size. Ensure you handle the edges by averaging whatever smaller window is available at the start. Return a new list of readings where the original value is replaced by the smoothed average value.
text_nat:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Normalize a raw reading into a [timestamp, float value] pair.
 */
function normalizeReading(array $reading): array
{
    if (count($reading) < 2) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('A reading needs a timestamp and a value.');
    }
    [$timestamp, $value] = $reading;
    if (!is_numeric($value)) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException("Non-numeric value at {$timestamp}.");
    }
    return [trim((string)$timestamp), (float)$value];
}

/**
 * Simple moving average with shrinking windows at the leading edge.
 */
function smooth(array $readings, int $window): array
{
    if ($window < 1) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Window size must be at least 1.');
    }
    $smoothed = [];
    $values = [];
    foreach ($readings as $reading) {
        [$timestamp, $value] = normalizeReading($reading);
        $values[] = $value;
        $frame = array_slice($values, -$window);
        $smoothed[] = [$timestamp, array_sum($frame) / count($frame)];
    }
    return $smoothed;
}

/**
 * Descriptive statistics over the value column of a reading list.
 */
function summarize(array $readings): array
{
    $values = array_column($readings, 1);
    return [
        'count' => count($values),
        'min' => min($values),
        'max' => max($values),
        'mean' => array_sum($values) / count($values),
    ];
}

function formatReadings(array $readings): string
{
    $lines = ['timestamp            value'];
    foreach ($readings as [$timestamp, $value]) {
        $lines[] = sprintf('%-20s %8.3f', $timestamp, $value);
    }
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

$raw = [
    ['2024-05-01T00:00:00', 12.0],
    ['2024-05-01T00:01:00', 18.5],
    ['2024-05-01T00:02:00', 9.25],
    ['2024-05-01T00:03:00', 14.0],
    ['2024-05-01T00:04:00', 21.75],
    ['2024-05-01T00:05:00', 11.5],
];

foreach ([1, 3, 4] as $window) {
    $result = smooth($raw, $window);
    echo "--- window {$window} ---", PHP_EOL;
    echo formatReadings($result), PHP_EOL;
    $stats = summarize($result);
    echo sprintf(
        "n=%d min=%.3f max=%.3f mean=%.3f%s%s",
        $stats['count'],
        $stats['min'],
        $stats['max'],
        $stats['mean'],
        PHP_EOL,
        PHP_EOL
    );
}

text_es: Implement `checkout(cart, catalog, discounts)`. The inputs are a cart list containing item names and quantities, a catalog list pairing items to unit prices, and a discounts list pairing items to percentage off integers. Calculate the subtotal for each item, apply any matching discounts, and calculate a flat ten percent tax on the discounted amount. Return a list containing the overall subtotal, total discount amount, tax amount, and the final grand total.
text_nat:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

const TAX_RATE = 0.10;

/**
 * Turn a list of [key, value] pairs into an associative lookup table.
 */
function indexPairs(array $pairs): array
{
    $map = [];
    foreach ($pairs as [$key, $value]) {
        $map[$key] = $value;
    }
    return $map;
}

/**
 * Compute [subtotal, discount, tax, grandTotal] for a cart.
 */
function checkout(array $cart, array $catalog, array $discounts): array
{
    $prices = indexPairs($catalog);
    $percents = indexPairs($discounts);
    $subtotal = 0.0;
    $discountTotal = 0.0;

    foreach ($cart as [$item, $quantity]) {
        if (!isset($prices[$item])) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("No catalog price for '$item'");
        }
        if ($quantity < 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Negative quantity for '$item'");
        }
        $line = $prices[$item] * $quantity;
        $subtotal += $line;
        $discountTotal += $line * (($percents[$item] ?? 0) / 100);
    }

    $taxable = $subtotal - $discountTotal;
    $tax = round($taxable * TAX_RATE, 2);
    return [round($subtotal, 2), round($discountTotal, 2), $tax, round($taxable + $tax, 2)];
}

/**
 * Build the printable receipt: one row per cart line plus the summary.
 */
function receiptLines(array $cart, array $catalog, array $discounts): array
{
    $prices = indexPairs($catalog);
    $percents = indexPairs($discounts);
    $lines = [];

    foreach ($cart as [$item, $quantity]) {
        $line = $prices[$item] * $quantity;
        $percent = $percents[$item] ?? 0;
        $note = $percent > 0 ? sprintf(' (-%d%%)', $percent) : '';
        $lines[] = sprintf('%-10s %3d x %6.2f = %7.2f%s', $item, $quantity, $prices[$item], $line, $note);
    }

    [$subtotal, $discount, $tax, $total] = checkout($cart, $catalog, $discounts);
    $summary = [
        ['Subtotal', $subtotal],
        ['Discounts', -$discount],
        ['Tax (10%)', $tax],
        ['Total', $total],
    ];
    foreach ($summary as [$label, $amount]) {
        $lines[] = sprintf('%-22s %7.2f', $label, $amount);
    }
    return $lines;
}

$cart = [
    ['apple', 6],
    ['bread', 2],
    ['cheese', 1],
];
$catalog = [
    ['apple', 0.55],
    ['bread', 2.40],
    ['cheese', 7.95],
];
$discounts = [
    ['apple', 20],
    ['cheese', 10],
];

foreach (receiptLines($cart, $catalog, $discounts) as $line) {
    echo $line, PHP_EOL;
}

text_es: Implement `scale(recipe, portions)`. The input is a recipe representing a list of ingredients where each element contains a name, a numeric amount, and a measurement unit string. The second input is a target number of portions. Multiply the amounts by the portions. If an amount in grams exceeds one thousand, convert it to kilograms by dividing by one thousand and updating the unit string. Return the updated list of scaled ingredients.
text_nat:
<?php

function scale(array $recipe, $portions)
{
    if (!is_numeric($portions) || $portions <= 0) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('portions must be a positive number');
    }

    $scaled = [];
    foreach ($recipe as $ingredient) {
        $amount = $ingredient['amount'] * $portions;
        $unit = $ingredient['unit'];

        if ($unit === 'g' && $amount > 1000) {
            $amount = $amount / 1000;
            $unit = 'kg';
        }

        $scaled[] = [
            'name' => $ingredient['name'],
            'amount' => $amount,
            'unit' => $unit,
        ];
    }

    return $scaled;
}

function formatAmount($amount)
{
    $rounded = round($amount, 3);
    if ($rounded == (int) $rounded) {
        return (string) (int) $rounded;
    }

    return rtrim(rtrim(number_format($rounded, 3, '.', ''), '0'), '.');
}

function formatIngredient(array $ingredient)
{
    return sprintf(
        '%s: %s %s',
        $ingredient['name'],
        formatAmount($ingredient['amount']),
        $ingredient['unit']
    );
}

function recipeReport(array $recipe, $portions)
{
    $lines = ['Recipe for ' . formatAmount($portions) . ' portion(s):'];
    foreach (scale($recipe, $portions) as $ingredient) {
        $lines[] = '  - ' . formatIngredient($ingredient);
    }

    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

$pancakes = [
    ['name' => 'flour', 'amount' => 120, 'unit' => 'g'],
    ['name' => 'milk', 'amount' => 250, 'unit' => 'ml'],
    ['name' => 'egg', 'amount' => 2, 'unit' => 'pcs'],
    ['name' => 'sugar', 'amount' => 30, 'unit' => 'g'],
    ['name' => 'salt', 'amount' => 0.5, 'unit' => 'tsp'],
];

foreach ([1, 4, 12] as $portions) {
    echo recipeReport($pancakes, $portions), PHP_EOL, PHP_EOL;
}

try {
    scale($pancakes, 0);
} catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
    echo 'Error: ', $e->getMessage(), PHP_EOL;
}

function scale(array $recipe, $portions)
{
    if (!is_numeric($portions) || $portions <= 0) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('portions must be a positive number');
    }

    $scaled = array();
    foreach ($recipe as $ingredient) {
        $amount = $ingredient['amount'] * $portions;
        $unit = $ingredient['unit'];

        if ($unit === 'g' && $amount > 1000) {
            $amount = $amount / 1000;
            $unit = 'kg';
        }

        $scaled[] = array(
            'name' => $ingredient['name'],
            'amount' => $amount,
            'unit' => $unit,
        );
    }

    return $scaled;
}

function formatAmount($amount)
{
    $rounded = round($amount, 3);
    if ($rounded == (int) $rounded) {
        return (string) (int) $rounded;
    }

    return rtrim(rtrim(number_format($rounded, 3, '.', ''), '0'), '.');
}

function formatIngredient(array $ingredient)
{
    return sprintf(
        '%s: %s %s',
        $ingredient['name'],
        formatAmount($ingredient['amount']),
        $ingredient['unit']
    );
}

function recipeReport(array $recipe, $portions)
{
    $lines = array('Recipe for ' . formatAmount($portions) . ' portion(s):');
    foreach (scale($recipe, $portions) as $ingredient) {
        $lines[] = '  - ' . formatIngredient($ingredient);
    }

    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

    array('name' => 'sugar', 'amount' => 30, 'unit' => 'g'),
    array('name' => 'salt', 'amount' => 0.5, 'unit' => 'tsp'),
);

foreach (array(1, 4, 12) as $portions) {
    echo recipeReport($pancakes, $portions), PHP_EOL, PHP_EOL;
}

try {
    scale($pancakes, 0);
} catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
    echo 'Error: ', $e->getMessage(), PHP_EOL;

text_es: Implement `clashes(events)`. The input is a list of events where each event is a list containing an event name, an integer start time, and an integer end time. Compare every event against all others to find overlapping times. Return a list of clashes where each clash is a list containing the names of the two overlapping events. Sort the pairs alphabetically internally and then sort the overall list to avoid any duplicate reporting.
text_nat:
<?php

function overlaps(array $a, array $b): bool
{
    [, $startA, $endA] = $a;
    [, $startB, $endB] = $b;

    return $startA < $endB && $startB < $endA;
}

function normalizeEvent($event): array
{
    if (!is_array($event) || count($event) !== 3) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Each event needs a name, a start and an end.');
    }

    [$name, $start, $end] = array_values($event);

    if (!is_int($start) || !is_int($end)) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException("Times of '$name' must be integers.");
    }

    if ($start > $end) {
        return [(string) $name, $end, $start];
    }

    return [(string) $name, $start, $end];
}

function clashes(array $events): array
{
    $normalized = array_map('normalizeEvent', $events);
    $found = [];
    $count = count($normalized);

    for ($i = 0; $i < $count; $i++) {
        for ($j = $i + 1; $j < $count; $j++) {
            if (!overlaps($normalized[$i], $normalized[$j])) {
                continue;
            }

            $pair = [$normalized[$i][0], $normalized[$j][0]];
            sort($pair);
            $found[implode("\0", $pair)] = $pair;
        }
    }

    $result = array_values($found);
    usort($result, function (array $left, array $right): int {
        return $left[0] <=> $right[0] ?: $left[1] <=> $right[1];
    });

    return $result;
}

function reportClashes(array $events): string
{
    $lines = [];

    foreach (clashes($events) as $pair) {
        $lines[] = sprintf('%s clashes with %s', $pair[0], $pair[1]);
    }

    if ($lines === []) {
        return 'No clashes found.';
    }

    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

$schedule = [
    ['Meeting', 9, 11],
    ['Standup', 10, 12],
    ['Lunch', 12, 13],
    ['Review', 12, 14],
    ['Retro', 13, 15],
    ['Training', 16, 18],
];

$soloTalk = ['Solo talk', 8, 9];

echo reportClashes($schedule), PHP_EOL;
echo reportClashes([$soloTalk]), PHP_EOL;

text_es: Implement `tally(ballots)`. The input is a list of ballots, where each ballot is a ranked list of candidate names. Count the first choice on each ballot. If no candidate has a strict majority of first choice votes, eliminate the candidate with the fewest votes, remove them from all ballots, and recount the updated first choices. Continue this process until a winner emerges. Return a list containing the winning candidate name and the number of elimination rounds it took.
text_nat:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function validateBallots(array $ballots): void
{
    foreach ($ballots as $index => $ballot) {
        if (!is_array($ballot)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Ballot $index is not a ranked list.");
        }
        if (count(array_unique($ballot)) !== count($ballot)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Ballot $index ranks a candidate twice.");
        }
    }
}

function countFirstChoices(array $ballots): array
{
    $counts = [];
    foreach ($ballots as $ballot) {
        if ($ballot === []) {
            continue;
        }
        $first = $ballot[0];
        $counts[$first] = ($counts[$first] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    ksort($counts);
    return $counts;
}

function majorityWinner(array $counts): ?string
{
    $total = array_sum($counts);
    foreach ($counts as $name => $votes) {
        if ($votes * 2 > $total) {
            return (string) $name;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

function weakestCandidate(array $counts): string
{
    $fewest = min($counts);
    $trailing = [];
    foreach ($counts as $name => $votes) {
        if ($votes === $fewest) {
            $trailing[] = (string) $name;
        }
    }
    sort($trailing);
    return $trailing[0];
}

function withoutCandidate(array $ballots, string $loser): array
{
    $trimmed = [];
    foreach ($ballots as $ballot) {
        $trimmed[] = array_values(array_filter($ballot, fn($name) => $name !== $loser));
    }
    return $trimmed;
}

function tally(array $ballots): array
{
    validateBallots($ballots);
    $rounds = 0;
    while (true) {
        $counts = countFirstChoices($ballots);
        if ($counts === []) {
            throw new RuntimeException('No votes remain to be counted.');
        }
        $winner = majorityWinner($counts);
        if ($winner !== null || count($counts) === 1) {
            return [$winner ?? (string) array_key_first($counts), $rounds];
        }
        $ballots = withoutCandidate($ballots, weakestCandidate($counts));
        $rounds++;
    }
}

function describe(array $result): string
{
    [$winner, $rounds] = $result;
    return sprintf('%s wins after %d elimination round(s).', $winner, $rounds);
}

$cityElection = [
    ['Ada', 'Bob', 'Cid'],
    ['Ada', 'Cid', 'Bob'],
    ['Bob', 'Cid', 'Ada'],
    ['Cid', 'Bob', 'Ada'],
    ['Cid', 'Ada', 'Bob'],
];
$clubElection = [
    ['Rose', 'Tulip'],

];

foreach (['City council' => $cityElection, 'Garden club' => $clubElection] as $label => $ballots) {
    echo $label, ': ', describe(tally($ballots)), PHP_EOL;
}

text_es: Implement `table(rows, headers)`. The inputs are a list of data rows and a list of column headers. Find the maximum string length for each column across both the headers and the data rows. Generate a list of strings representing a formatted markdown table. This includes the padded header row, a separator row made of dashes that matches the column widths, and the padded data rows, all separated by pipe characters.
text_nat:
<?php

function columnWidths(array $rows, array $headers): array
{
    $widths = [];
    foreach ($headers as $index => $header) {
        $widths[$index] = strlen((string)$header);
    }
    foreach ($rows as $row) {
        foreach (array_values($row) as $index => $cell) {
            $length = strlen((string)$cell);
            if (!isset($widths[$index]) || $length > $widths[$index]) {
                $widths[$index] = $length;
            }
        }
    }
    return $widths;
}

function formatRow(array $cells, array $widths): string
{
    $padded = [];
    foreach ($widths as $index => $width) {
        $cell = isset($cells[$index]) ? (string)$cells[$index] : '';
        $padded[] = str_pad($cell, $width);
    }
    return '| ' . implode(' | ', $padded) . ' |';
}

function separatorRow(array $widths): string
{
    $dashes = [];
    foreach ($widths as $width) {
        $dashes[] = str_repeat('-', $width);
    }
    return '| ' . implode(' | ', $dashes) . ' |';
}

function table(array $rows, array $headers): array
{
    $widths = columnWidths($rows, $headers);
    $lines = [formatRow(array_values($headers), $widths)];
    $lines[] = separatorRow($widths);
    foreach ($rows as $row) {
        $lines[] = formatRow(array_values($row), $widths);
    }
    return $lines;
}

    ['galvanised washer', 96, '0.11'],

text_es: Implement `restock(inventory, thresholds)`. The inputs are an inventory list mapping item names to current quantities, and a thresholds list mapping items to their minimum required levels. Identify items that fall strictly below their threshold. Calculate the order quantity needed to bring them back up to exactly double their threshold. Return a list of lists, where each inner list contains the item name and the calculated order quantity.
text_nat:
<?php

function restock(array $inventory, array $thresholds): array
{
    $orders = [];
    foreach ($thresholds as $item => $threshold) {
        $quantity = $inventory[$item] ?? 0;
        if ($quantity < $threshold) {
            $orders[] = [$item, $threshold * 2 - $quantity];
        }
    }
    return $orders;
}

function validateLevels(array $levels, string $label): array
{
    $problems = [];
    foreach ($levels as $item => $value) {
        if (!is_int($value)) {
            $problems[] = "$label: '$item' has a non-integer level";
        } elseif ($value < 0) {
            $problems[] = "$label: '$item' has a negative level ($value)";
        }
    }
    return $problems;
}

function untrackedItems(array $inventory, array $thresholds): array
{
    return array_keys(array_diff_key($inventory, $thresholds));
}

function formatOrders(array $orders): string
{
    if ($orders === []) {
        return "Nothing to restock.";
    }
    $lines = ["Purchase order:"];
    $total = 0;
    foreach ($orders as [$item, $quantity]) {
        $lines[] = sprintf("  %-10s %4d", $item, $quantity);
        $total += $quantity;
    }
    $lines[] = sprintf("  %-10s %4d", "TOTAL", $total);
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

    "widget" => 3,
    "gadget" => 20,
    "bolt" => 0,
    "nut" => 14,
    "glue" => 7,
];

$thresholds = [
    "widget" => 10,
    "gadget" => 15,
    "bolt" => 25,
    "nut" => 14,
    "washer" => 5,
];

foreach (array_merge(validateLevels($inventory, "inventory"), validateLevels($thresholds, "thresholds")) as $problem) {
    fwrite(STDERR, $problem . PHP_EOL);
}

$orders = restock($inventory, $thresholds);
echo formatOrders($orders), PHP_EOL;

$extra = untrackedItems($inventory, $thresholds);
if ($extra !== []) {
    echo "Untracked stock: ", implode(", ", $extra), PHP_EOL;
}

text_es: Implement `resolve(packages)`. The input is a list of package requirements where each requirement contains a package name and a list of its dependencies. Perform a topological sort to determine the safe installation order. If a circular dependency is detected during the traversal, return a list containing a single error string. Otherwise, return the ordered list of package names ready for installation.
text_nat:
<?php

function pkg(string $name, array $deps): array
{
    return ['name' => $name, 'deps' => $deps];
}

function buildGraph(array $packages): array
{
    $graph = [];
    foreach ($packages as $requirement) {
        $name = $requirement['name'];
        if (!isset($graph[$name])) {
            $graph[$name] = [];
        }
        foreach ($requirement['deps'] as $dependency) {
            if (!isset($graph[$dependency])) {
                $graph[$dependency] = [];
            }
            $graph[$name][] = $dependency;
        }
    }
    return $graph;
}

function visit(string $node, array $graph, array &$state, array &$order, array $stack): array
{
    $status = $state[$node] ?? 'new';
    if ($status === 'done') {
        return [];
    }
    if ($status === 'open') {
        $cycle = array_slice($stack, (int) array_search($node, $stack, true));
        $cycle[] = $node;
        return $cycle;
    }
    $state[$node] = 'open';
    $stack[] = $node;
    foreach ($graph[$node] as $dependency) {
        $cycle = visit($dependency, $graph, $state, $order, $stack);
        if ($cycle !== []) {
            return $cycle;
        }
    }
    $state[$node] = 'done';
    $order[] = $node;
    return [];
}

function resolve(array $packages): array
{
    $graph = buildGraph($packages);
    $state = [];
    $order = [];
    foreach (array_keys($graph) as $node) {
        $cycle = visit($node, $graph, $state, $order, []);
        if ($cycle !== []) {
            return ['error: circular dependency ' . implode(' -> ', $cycle)];
        }
    }
    return $order;
}

function formatPlan(array $result): string
{
    if (count($result) === 1 && strpos($result[0], 'error:') === 0) {
        return $result[0];
    }
    $lines = [];
    foreach ($result as $step => $name) {
        $lines[] = sprintf('%d. install %s', $step + 1, $name);
    }
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

$application = [
    pkg('web-app', ['router', 'template-engine']),
    pkg('router', ['http-core']),
    pkg('template-engine', ['http-core', 'cache']),
    pkg('cache', ['logger']),
    pkg('http-core', ['logger']),
    pkg('logger', []),
];

$broken = [
    pkg('alpha', ['beta']),
    pkg('beta', ['gamma']),
    pkg('gamma', ['alpha']),
];

echo formatPlan(resolve($application)), PHP_EOL, PHP_EOL;

<?php

function pkg(string $name, array $deps): array
{
    return array('name' => $name, 'deps' => $deps);
}

function buildGraph(array $packages): array
{
    $graph = array();
    foreach ($packages as $requirement) {
        $name = $requirement['name'];
        if (!isset($graph[$name])) {
            $graph[$name] = array();
        }
        foreach ($requirement['deps'] as $dependency) {
            if (!isset($graph[$dependency])) {
                $graph[$dependency] = array();
            }
            $graph[$name][] = $dependency;
        }
    }
    return $graph;
}

function visit(string $node, array $graph, array &$state, array &$order, array $stack): array
{
    $status = $state[$node] ?? 'new';
    if ($status === 'done') {
        return array();
    }
    if ($status === 'open') {
        $cycle = array_slice($stack, (int) array_search($node, $stack, true));
        $cycle[] = $node;
        return $cycle;
    }
    $state[$node] = 'open';
    $stack[] = $node;
    foreach ($graph[$node] as $dependency) {
        $cycle = visit($dependency, $graph, $state, $order, $stack);
        if ($cycle !== array()) {
            return $cycle;
        }
    }
    $state[$node] = 'done';
    $order[] = $node;
    return array();
}

function resolve(array $packages): array
{
    $graph = buildGraph($packages);
    $state = array();
    $order = array();
    foreach (array_keys($graph) as $node) {
        $cycle = visit($node, $graph, $state, $order, array());
        if ($cycle !== array()) {
            return array('error: circular dependency ' . implode(' -> ', $cycle));
        }
    }
    return $order;
}

function formatPlan(array $result): string
{
    if (count($result) === 1 && strpos($result[0], 'error:') === 0) {
        return $result[0];
    }
    $lines = array();
    foreach ($result as $step => $name) {
        $lines[] = sprintf('%d. install %s', $step + 1, $name);
    }
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

Use a breadth first search to find the shortest path from the start city to the destination city. Keep track of visited cities and the paths taken to reach them. Return a list of city names representing the optimal path, or an empty list if no path is found.

<?php

function buildGraph(array $flights): array
{
    $graph = [];
    foreach ($flights as $flight) {
        [$from, $to] = $flight;
        if (!isset($graph[$from])) {
            $graph[$from] = [];
        }
        if (!isset($graph[$to])) {
            $graph[$to] = [];
        }
        $graph[$from][] = $to;
        $graph[$to][] = $from;
    }
    return $graph;
}

function route(array $flights, string $start, string $destination): array
{
    $graph = buildGraph($flights);
    if (!isset($graph[$start]) || !isset($graph[$destination])) {
        return [];
    }
    if ($start === $destination) {
        return [$start];
    }
    $visited = [$start => true];
    $firstPath = [$start];
    $queue = [$firstPath];
    while ($queue) {
        $path = array_shift($queue);
        $city = end($path);
        foreach ($graph[$city] as $next) {
            if (isset($visited[$next])) {
                continue;
            }
            $visited[$next] = true;
            $extended = array_merge($path, [$next]);
            if ($next === $destination) {
                return $extended;
            }
            $queue[] = $extended;
        }
    }
    return [];
}

{
    $path = route($flights, $start, $destination);
    if (!$path) {
        return "No route from $start to $destination";
    }
    $hops = count($path) - 1;
    return implode(' -> ', $path) . " ($hops flight" . ($hops === 1 ? '' : 's') . ')';
}

text_es: Implement `wrap(text, limit)`. The input is a single long string of text and an integer line limit. Split the text into individual words based on spaces. Build lines of text by appending words one by one, ensuring that adding another word and a space would not exceed the character limit. Return a list of the wrapped lines. For example, wrapping a short sentence with a small limit returns a list of very short string lines.
text_nat:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Greedily wrap a single long string into lines no longer than $limit characters.
 */
function wrap(string $text, int $limit): array
{
    if ($limit < 1) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('The line limit must be at least 1 character.');
    }

    $words = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($text), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
    $lines = [];
    $current = '';

    foreach ($words as $word) {
        if (strlen($word) > $limit) {
            if ($current !== '') {
                $lines[] = $current;
                $current = '';
            }
            $chunks = str_split($word, $limit);
            $current = array_pop($chunks);
            $lines = array_merge($lines, $chunks);
        } elseif ($current === '') {
            $current = $word;
        } elseif (strlen($current) + 1 + strlen($word) <= $limit) {
            $current .= ' ' . $word;
        } else {
            $lines[] = $current;
            $current = $word;
        }
    }

    if ($current !== '') {
        $lines[] = $current;
    }

    return $lines;
}

/** Wrap a text that contains blank-line separated paragraphs, keeping the blank lines. */
function wrapParagraphs(string $text, int $limit): array
{
    $paragraphs = preg_split('/\R\s*\R/', trim($text), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
    $out = [];

    foreach ($paragraphs as $paragraph) {
        if ($out !== []) {
            $out = array_merge($out, ['']);
        }
        $out = array_merge($out, wrap($paragraph, $limit));
    }

    return $out;
}

/** Indent wrapped lines for display. */
function formatBlock(array $lines, string $prefix): array
{
    return array_map(static fn(string $line): string => rtrim($prefix . $line), $lines);
}

function lineStats(array $lines): array
{
    $lengths = array_map('strlen', $lines);

    return [
        'lines' => count($lines),
        'longest' => $lengths === [] ? 0 : max($lengths),
    ];
}

$samples = [
    ['limit' => 20, 'text' => 'In the beginning the Universe was created. This has made a lot of people very angry.'],
    ['limit' => 12, 'text' => 'Wrapping text is a surprisingly antidisestablishmentarianism-heavy exercise.'],
    ['limit' => 34, 'text' => "First paragraph of the report goes here.\n\nSecond paragraph follows the blank line."],
];

foreach ($samples as $index => $sample) {
    $lines = wrapParagraphs($sample['text'], $sample['limit']);
    $stats = lineStats($lines);
    printf("Sample %d (limit %d, %d lines, longest %d)\n", $index + 1, $sample['limit'], $stats['lines'], $stats['longest']);
    echo implode("\n", formatBlock($lines, '  | ')), "\n\n";
}

echo implode("\n", wrap('The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog', 10)), "\n";

text_es: Implement `rebalance(portfolio, targets, cash)`. The inputs are a current portfolio list mapping asset symbols to their held values, a target allocations list mapping symbols to percentage weights, and an available cash amount integer. Calculate the total future value by summing the current portfolio and the cash. Determine the ideal value for each asset based on its target percentage. Return a list mapping each symbol to the monetary amount that must be bought or sold to reach the target.
text_nat:
<?php

function validateAllocations(array $targets): void
{
    if ($targets === []) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('No target allocations given');
    }
    $total = 0.0;
    foreach ($targets as $symbol => $weight) {
        if (!is_numeric($weight) || $weight < 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Invalid target weight for {$symbol}");
        }
        $total += (float) $weight;
    }
    if (abs($total - 100.0) > 1e-9) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException(sprintf('Weights sum to %.4f%%, expected 100%%', $total));
    }
}

function futureValue(array $portfolio, int $cash): float
{
    return array_sum($portfolio) + $cash;
}

function rebalance(array $portfolio, array $targets, int $cash): array
{
    validateAllocations($targets);
    $total = futureValue($portfolio, $cash);
    $orders = [];
    foreach ($targets as $symbol => $weight) {
        $ideal = $total * (float) $weight / 100.0;
        $held = (float) ($portfolio[$symbol] ?? 0.0);
        $orders[$symbol] = round($ideal - $held, 2);
    }
    foreach ($portfolio as $symbol => $held) {
        if (!array_key_exists($symbol, $targets)) {
            $orders[$symbol] = round(-(float) $held, 2);
        }
    }
    return $orders;
}

function orderRows(array $orders): array
{
    $rows = [];
    foreach ($orders as $symbol => $amount) {
        $action = $amount > 0 ? 'BUY' : ($amount < 0 ? 'SELL' : 'HOLD');
        $rows[] = [$symbol, $action, number_format(abs($amount), 2)];
    }
    return $rows;
}

function renderTable(array $rows, array $headers): string
{
    $widths = [];
    foreach (array_merge([$headers], $rows) as $row) {
        foreach ($row as $i => $cell) {
            $widths[$i] = max($widths[$i] ?? 0, strlen($cell));
        }
    }
    $lines = [];
    foreach (array_merge([$headers], $rows) as $row) {
        $cells = [];
        foreach ($row as $i => $cell) {
            $cells[] = str_pad($cell, $widths[$i]);
        }
        $lines[] = rtrim(implode('  ', $cells));
    }
    return implode("\n", $lines);
}

    'BONDS' => 3000.0,
    'CRYPTO' => 500.0,
];

    'BONDS' => 30,
    'GOLD' => 10,
];
$cash = 2500;

$orders = rebalance($portfolio, $targets, $cash);
printf("Total future value: %s\n", number_format(futureValue($portfolio, $cash), 2));
echo renderTable(orderRows($orders), ['Asset', 'Action', 'Amount']), "\n";

text_es: Implement `anagrams(words)`. The input is a list of string words. Group words that are anagrams of each other together. Achieve this by sorting the characters of each word alphabetically to form a common grouping key. Filter out any groups that contain only a single word. Finally, sort the remaining groups by the number of words they contain in descending order, and return a list of these groups.
text_nat:
<?php

function anagramKey(string $word): string
{
    $letters = str_split(mb_strtolower($word));
    sort($letters);
    return implode('', $letters);
}

function normalizeWords(array $words): array
{
    $clean = [];
    foreach ($words as $word) {
        $trimmed = trim($word);
        if ($trimmed !== '') {
            $clean[] = $trimmed;
        }
    }
    return $clean;
}

function anagrams(array $words): array
{
    $buckets = [];
    foreach (normalizeWords($words) as $word) {
        $key = anagramKey($word);
        if (!isset($buckets[$key])) {
            $buckets[$key] = [];
        }
        $buckets[$key][] = $word;
    }

    $groups = [];
    foreach ($buckets as $group) {
        if (count($group) > 1) {
            $groups[] = $group;
        }
    }

    usort($groups, function (array $a, array $b): int {
        return count($b) <=> count($a);
    });

    return $groups;
}

function formatGroups(array $groups): string
{
    $lines = [];
    foreach ($groups as $index => $group) {
        $lines[] = sprintf('%d. (%d) %s', $index + 1, count($group), implode(', ', $group));
    }
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

function loadWords(string $path): array
{
    $contents = @file_get_contents($path);
    if ($contents === false) {
        return [];
    }
    return preg_split('/\s+/', $contents, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
}

text_es: Implement `parse(logs)`. The input is a list of raw log strings, each containing a severity level, a date, and a message. Extract these three components for each line using string splitting. Group the messages by their severity level into separate categories. Return a list of severity levels, each paired with a chronologically ordered list of its extracted messages.
text_nat:
<?php

function splitLogLine(string $line): array
{
    $parts = array_map('trim', explode('|', $line, 3));
    if (count($parts) !== 3) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException("malformed log entry: $line");
    }
    [$level, $date, $message] = $parts;
    if ($level === '' || $date === '' || $message === '') {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException("incomplete log entry: $line");
    }
    return [
        'level' => strtoupper($level),
        'date' => $date,
        'message' => $message,
    ];
}

function severityRank(string $level): int
{
    $order = [
        'FATAL' => 0,
        'ERROR' => 1,
        'WARNING' => 2,
        'INFO' => 3,
        'DEBUG' => 4,
    ];
    return $order[$level] ?? count($order);
}

function parse(array $logs): array
{
    $groups = [];
    foreach ($logs as $line) {
        $entry = splitLogLine($line);
        $groups[$entry['level']][] = [$entry['date'], $entry['message']];
    }

    $levels = array_keys($groups);
    usort($levels, function ($a, $b) {
        $byRank = severityRank($a) <=> severityRank($b);
        return $byRank !== 0 ? $byRank : strcmp($a, $b);
    });

    $result = [];
    foreach ($levels as $level) {
        $records = $groups[$level];
        usort($records, fn($x, $y) => $x[0] <=> $y[0]);
        $messages = array_map(fn($record) => $record[1], $records);
        $result[] = [$level, $messages];
    }
    return $result;
}

function formatReport(array $parsed): string
{
    $lines = [];
    foreach ($parsed as [$level, $messages]) {
        $lines[] = sprintf('%s (%d)', $level, count($messages));
        foreach ($messages as $message) {
            $lines[] = '  - ' . $message;
        }
    }
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

    'INFO | 2023-05-30 | nightly backup finished',

];

text_es: Implement `tree(paths)`. The input is a list of file paths represented as strings separated by forward slashes. Convert this flat list into a nested hierarchical structure where each directory contains further directories or file names. Use lists to represent the children of each directory. Return the root level structure containing all nested paths properly organized.
text_nat:
<?php

/**
 * Split a slash separated path into its meaningful segments.
 */
function splitPath(string $path): array
{
    $parts = [];
    foreach (explode('/', $path) as $segment) {
        $segment = trim($segment);
        if ($segment !== '' && $segment !== '.') {
            $parts[] = $segment;
        }
    }
    return $parts;
}

/**
 * Insert one already split path into a node (a list of children).
 * Files are stored as plain strings, directories as [name => children].
 */
function insertPath(array &$node, array $parts): void
{
    $name = array_shift($parts);
    if ($parts === []) {
        if (!in_array($name, $node, true)) {
            $node[] = $name;
        }
        return;
    }
    foreach ($node as &$child) {
        if (is_array($child) && array_key_exists($name, $child)) {
            insertPath($child[$name], $parts);
            return;
        }
    }
    unset($child);
    $children = [];
    $node[] = [$name => $children];
    insertPath($node[count($node) - 1][$name], $parts);
}

function tree(array $paths): array
{
    $root = [];
    foreach ($paths as $path) {
        $parts = splitPath($path);
        if ($parts !== []) {
            insertPath($root, $parts);
        }
    }
    return $root;
}

/**
 * Order every level: directories first, then files, both alphabetically.
 */
function sortNode(array $node): array
{
    $dirs = [];
    $files = [];
    foreach ($node as $child) {
        if (is_array($child)) {
            $name = array_key_first($child);
            $dirs[$name] = sortNode($child[$name]);
        } else {
            $files[] = $child;
        }
    }
    ksort($dirs);
    sort($files);
    $out = [];
    foreach ($dirs as $name => $children) {
        $out[] = [$name => $children];
    }
    foreach ($files as $file) {
        $out[] = $file;
    }
    return $out;
}

function renderTree(array $node, string $indent = ''): array
{
    $lines = [];
    $total = count($node);
    $index = 0;
    foreach ($node as $child) {
        $isLast = (++$index === $total);
        $branch = $isLast ? '`-- ' : '|-- ';
        $pad = $isLast ? '    ' : '|   ';
        if (is_array($child)) {
            $name = array_key_first($child);
            $lines[] = $indent . $branch . $name . '/';
            $lines = array_merge($lines, renderTree($child[$name], $indent . $pad));
        } else {
            $lines[] = $indent . $branch . $child;
        }
    }
    return $lines;
}

$paths = [
    'src/app/main.php',
    'src/app/helpers/string.php',
    'src/app/helpers/array.php',
    'src/lib/parser.php',
    'README.md',
    'tests/unit/parser_test.php',
    'tests/README.md',
];

$structure = sortNode(tree($paths));
echo '.', PHP_EOL;
echo implode(PHP_EOL, renderTree($structure)), PHP_EOL;
echo json_encode($structure, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES), PHP_EOL;

text_es: Implement `grades(scores)`. The input is a list of student records, where each record contains a student name and a list of numerical test scores. Calculate the arithmetic average score for each student. Assign a standard letter grade based on standard decile thresholds from ninety down to sixty. Return a list where each element is a list containing the student name, their average score, and their letter grade.
text_nat:
<?php

function averageScore(array $tests): float
{
    return array_sum($tests) / count($tests);
}

function letterGrade(float $average): string
{
    $thresholds = [
        [90, 'A'],
        [80, 'B'],
        [70, 'C'],
        [60, 'D'],
    ];
    foreach ($thresholds as $band) {
        [$cutoff, $letter] = $band;
        if ($average >= $cutoff) {
            return $letter;
        }
    }
    return 'F';
}

function normalizeRecord($record): array
{
    if (!is_array($record) || count($record) < 2) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Each record needs a name and a score list.');
    }
    $name = (string) $record[0];
    $tests = is_array($record[1]) ? $record[1] : [$record[1]];
    if (count($tests) === 0) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException("No scores recorded for $name.");
    }
    foreach ($tests as $score) {
        if (!is_numeric($score)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Non-numeric score for student $name.");
        }
    }
    return [$name, array_map('floatval', array_values($tests))];
}

function grades(array $scores): array
{
    $report = [];
    foreach ($scores as $record) {
        [$name, $tests] = normalizeRecord($record);
        $average = averageScore($tests);
        $report[] = [$name, $average, letterGrade($average)];
    }
    return $report;
}

text_es: Implement `tickets(requests, rules)`. The inputs are a list of age requests and rules dictating integer prices for children, adults, and seniors. Calculate the individual price for each person by checking their age against the rule brackets. Apply a flat group discount of twenty percent to the total if there are more than five requests. Return a list containing the original total, the discount amount applied, and the final price to pay.
text_nat:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

function normalizeRules(array $rules): array
{
    $brackets = [];
    foreach ($rules as $name => $rule) {
        if (!isset($rule['max_age'], $rule['price'])) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Rule '$name' needs a max_age and a price.");
        }
        $brackets[] = ['name' => (string)$name, 'max_age' => (int)$rule['max_age'], 'price' => (int)$rule['price']];
    }
    usort($brackets, static fn(array $a, array $b): int => $a['max_age'] <=> $b['max_age']);
    return $brackets;
}

function bracketFor(int $age, array $brackets): array
{
    if ($age < 0) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException("Age $age is not a valid request.");
    }
    foreach ($brackets as $bracket) {
        if ($age <= $bracket['max_age']) {
            return $bracket;
        }
    }
    throw new InvalidArgumentException("No rule covers age $age.");
}

function tickets(array $requests, array $rules): array
{
    $brackets = normalizeRules($rules);
    $total = 0;
    foreach ($requests as $age) {
        $total += bracketFor((int)$age, $brackets)['price'];
    }
    $discount = count($requests) > 5 ? intdiv($total * 20, 100) : 0;
    return [$total, $discount, $total - $discount];
}

function breakdown(array $requests, array $rules): array
{
    $brackets = normalizeRules($rules);
    $groups = [];
    foreach ($requests as $age) {
        $bracket = bracketFor((int)$age, $brackets);
        $name = $bracket['name'];
        if (!isset($groups[$name])) {
            $groups[$name] = ['count' => 0, 'subtotal' => 0];
        }
        $groups[$name]['count']++;
        $groups[$name]['subtotal'] += $bracket['price'];
    }
    return $groups;
}

function formatReceipt(array $requests, array $rules): string
{
    [$total, $discount, $toPay] = tickets($requests, $rules);
    $lines = [sprintf('%d request(s)', count($requests))];
    foreach (breakdown($requests, $rules) as $name => $group) {
        $lines[] = sprintf('  %-8s x%-2d %5d', $name, $group['count'], $group['subtotal']);
    }
    $lines[] = sprintf('  %-12s %5d', 'total', $total);
    $lines[] = sprintf('  %-12s %5d', 'discount', $discount);
    $lines[] = sprintf('  %-12s %5d', 'to pay', $toPay);
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

$rules = [
    'child' => ['max_age' => 12, 'price' => 8],
    'adult' => ['max_age' => 64, 'price' => 15],
    'senior' => ['max_age' => 120, 'price' => 10],
];

$bookings = [
    'family outing' => [4, 9, 34, 41, 70],
    'school trip' => [7, 8, 8, 11, 12, 39, 45],
    'retirement club' => [3, 18, 66, 70, 71, 25],
];

foreach ($bookings as $label => $requests) {
    echo $label, PHP_EOL, formatReceipt($requests, $rules), PHP_EOL, PHP_EOL;
}

Split it by ampersands to isolate the key and value pairs. Split each pair by the equals sign. Group values into a list if the exact same key appears multiple times in the query. Return a structured list representation of the parsed keys and their respective values.
text_nat:
<?php

function decodeComponent($text)
{
    return rawurldecode(str_replace('+', ' ', $text));
}

function splitPair($pair)
{
    $eq = strpos($pair, '=');
    if ($eq === false) {
        return [decodeComponent($pair), ''];
    }
    $key = substr($pair, 0, $eq);
    $value = substr($pair, $eq + 1);
    return [decodeComponent($key), decodeComponent($value)];
}

function querystring($url)
{
    $mark = strpos($url, '?');
    if ($mark === false) {
        return [];
    }
    $query = substr($url, $mark + 1);
    $fragment = strpos($query, '#');
    if ($fragment !== false) {
        $query = substr($query, 0, $fragment);
    }
    $parsed = [];
    foreach (explode('&', $query) as $pair) {
        if ($pair === '') {
            continue;
        }
        list($key, $value) = splitPair($pair);
        if (!array_key_exists($key, $parsed)) {
            $parsed[$key] = $value;
        } elseif (is_array($parsed[$key])) {
            $parsed[$key][] = $value;
        } else {
            $parsed[$key] = [$parsed[$key], $value];
        }
    }
    return $parsed;
}

function valuesOf($parsed, $key)
{
    $value = $parsed[$key];
    return is_array($value) ? $value : [$value];
}

function formatQuerystring($parsed)
{
    $lines = [];
    foreach (array_keys($parsed) as $key) {
        $values = valuesOf($parsed, $key);
        $shown = array_map(function ($v) { return $v === '' ? '(empty)' : $v; }, $values);
        $lines[] = sprintf('  %-10s => %s', $key, implode(', ', $shown));
    }
    if (!$lines) {
        $lines[] = '  (no query parameters)';
    }
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

text_es: Implement `poker(hand)`. The input is a list of five cards, where each card is a list containing a suit string and an integer value. Determine if the hand contains a flush, meaning all cards share the same suit, or a straight, meaning the five values are consecutive when sorted. Return a list containing a boolean indicating a flush, a boolean indicating a straight, and the highest card value found in the hand.
text_nat:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function faceName(int $value): string
{
    $names = [11 => 'J', 12 => 'Q', 13 => 'K', 14 => 'A'];
    return $names[$value] ?? (string) $value;
}

function validateHand(array $hand): void
{
    $allowedSuits = ['C', 'D', 'H', 'S'];
    if (count($hand) !== 5) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('a hand must hold exactly five cards');
    }
    foreach ($hand as $index => $card) {
        if (!is_array($card) || count($card) !== 2) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("card $index must be a suit/value pair");
        }
        if (!in_array($card[0], $allowedSuits, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("card $index has an unknown suit");
        }
        if (!is_int($card[1]) || $card[1] < 2 || $card[1] > 14) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("card $index has a value outside 2..14");
        }
    }
}

function poker(array $hand): array
{
    validateHand($hand);
    $suits = [];
    $values = [];
    foreach ($hand as [$suit, $value]) {
        $suits[] = $suit;
        $values[] = $value;
    }
    sort($values);
    $flush = count(array_unique($suits)) === 1;
    $straight = true;
    for ($i = 1; $i < 5; $i++) {
        if ($values[$i] !== $values[$i - 1] + 1) {
            $straight = false;
        }
    }
    return [$flush, $straight, $values[4]];
}

function formatHand(array $hand): string
{
    $parts = [];
    foreach ($hand as [$suit, $value]) {
        $parts[] = $suit . faceName($value);
    }
    return implode(' ', $parts);
}

function describeHand(array $hand): string
{
    [$flush, $straight, $high] = poker($hand);
    $tags = [];
    if ($flush) {
        $tags[] = 'flush';
    }
    if ($straight) {
        $tags[] = 'straight';
    }
    if ($tags === []) {
        $tags[] = 'no flush, no straight';
    }
    return sprintf('%-22s -> %-22s high card %s', formatHand($hand), implode(' + ', $tags), faceName($high));
}

$straightOnly = [

];

foreach ([$straightFlush, $flushOnly, $straightOnly, $mixedHand] as $hand) {
    echo describeHand($hand), PHP_EOL;
}

text_es: Implement `delivery(locations)`. The input is a list of delivery locations, where each location contains a name and horizontal and vertical coordinates. Starting from the first location in the list, repeatedly find the nearest unvisited location using simple straight line mathematical distance. Keep appending the closest location to your route. Return a list of location names in the optimal order they should be visited.
text_nat:
<?php

function locationName(array $location): string
{
    return $location['name'] ?? $location[0];
}

function locationPoint(array $location): array
{
    if (isset($location['x'], $location['y'])) {
        return [(float)$location['x'], (float)$location['y']];
    }
    return [(float)$location[1], (float)$location[2]];
}

function distance(array $from, array $to): float
{
    [$x1, $y1] = locationPoint($from);
    [$x2, $y2] = locationPoint($to);
    return sqrt(($x2 - $x1) ** 2 + ($y2 - $y1) ** 2);
}

function nearestIndex(array $current, array $candidates): int
{
    $bestIndex = array_key_first($candidates);
    $bestDistance = distance($current, $candidates[$bestIndex]);
    foreach ($candidates as $index => $candidate) {
        $gap = distance($current, $candidate);
        if ($gap < $bestDistance) {
            $bestDistance = $gap;
            $bestIndex = $index;
        }
    }
    return $bestIndex;
}

function delivery(array $locations): array
{
    if ($locations === []) {
        return [];
    }
    $remaining = array_values($locations);
    $current = array_shift($remaining);
    $route = [locationName($current)];
    while ($remaining !== []) {
        $index = nearestIndex($current, $remaining);
        $current = $remaining[$index];
        unset($remaining[$index]);
        $remaining = array_values($remaining);
        $route[] = locationName($current);
    }
    return $route;
}

function routeReport(array $locations): string
{
    $order = delivery($locations);
    $byName = [];
    foreach ($locations as $location) {
        $byName[locationName($location)] = $location;
    }
    $total = 0.0;
    $legs = [];
    for ($i = 1, $n = count($order); $i < $n; $i++) {
        $leg = distance($byName[$order[$i - 1]], $byName[$order[$i]]);
        $total += $leg;
        $legs[] = sprintf('%s -> %s (%.2f)', $order[$i - 1], $order[$i], $leg);
    }
    return implode("\n", $legs) . sprintf("\nTotal: %.2f\n", $total);
}

text_es: Implement `frequencies(document)`. The input is a paragraph of plain text. Convert the entire text to lowercase and remove all punctuation characters. Split the text into individual words using spaces. Count the frequency of each word using a tracking structure. Filter out common stop words like the, and, or. Return a list of the top five most frequent words paired with their integer counts, sorted from highest to lowest.
text_nat:
<?php

function stopWords(): array
{
    return [
        'the', 'and', 'or', 'a', 'an', 'of', 'to', 'in', 'is', 'it',
        'that', 'this', 'with', 'for', 'on', 'as', 'was', 'were', 'be', 'by',
        'at', 'from', 'but', 'not', 'are', 'its', 'has', 'have', 'had', 'so',
    ];
}

function normalize(string $document): string
{
    $lowered = mb_strtolower($document, 'UTF-8');
    $replacements = [
        '/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]+/u' => ' ',
        '/\s+/u' => ' ',
    ];

    $cleaned = preg_replace(array_keys($replacements), array_values($replacements), $lowered);

    return trim($cleaned);
}

function tokenize(string $document): array
{
    $text = normalize($document);
    if ($text === '') {
        return [];
    }

    return explode(' ', $text);
}

function countWords(array $words): array
{
    $stops = array_fill_keys(stopWords(), true);
    $counts = [];

    foreach ($words as $word) {
        if (isset($stops[$word])) {
            continue;
        }
        $counts[$word] = ($counts[$word] ?? 0) + 1;
    }

    return $counts;
}

function frequencies(string $document): array
{
    $counts = countWords(tokenize($document));

    uksort($counts, function ($left, $right) use ($counts) {
        $byCount = $counts[$right] <=> $counts[$left];

        return $byCount !== 0 ? $byCount : $left <=> $right;
    });

    $top = [];
    foreach (array_slice($counts, 0, 5, true) as $word => $count) {
        $top[] = [$word, (int) $count];
    }

    return $top;
}

function formatReport(array $ranking): string
{
    $lines = ['rank  word            count'];
    foreach ($ranking as $index => $entry) {
        [$word, $count] = $entry;
        $lines[] = sprintf('%-5d %-15s %d', $index + 1, $word, $count);
    }

    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

for the bridge over the river had fallen in the storm. A ferryman waited by the
bridge; the ferryman knew the river, and the river knew the ferryman. Storm after
storm, the bridge stayed broken, so the ferryman rowed the travellers across.
TEXT;

echo formatReport(frequencies($document)), PHP_EOL;

text_es: Implement `maze(grid)`. The input is a two dimensional grid list representing a maze where zeroes are open paths and ones are solid walls. Find a path from the top left corner to the bottom right corner by checking adjacent cells. Keep track of visited coordinates in a dedicated list to avoid getting stuck in loops. Return a list of coordinate pairs representing the successful route, or an empty list if no route exists.
text_nat:
<?php

function inBounds(array $grid, int $r, int $c): bool
{
    return $r >= 0 && $r < count($grid) && $c >= 0 && $c < count($grid[$r]);
}

function neighbors(int $r, int $c): array
{
    return [
        [$r - 1, $c],
        [$r, $c + 1],
        [$r + 1, $c],
        [$r, $c - 1],
    ];
}

function buildPath(array $parents, array $start, array $end): array
{
    $path = [$end];
    $cur = $end;
    while ($cur !== $start) {
        $cur = $parents[$cur[0] . ',' . $cur[1]];
        $path[] = $cur;
    }
    return array_reverse($path);
}

function maze(array $grid): array
{
    if (count($grid) === 0 || count($grid[0]) === 0) {
        return [];
    }
    $lastRow = count($grid) - 1;

<?php

function inBounds(array $grid, int $r, int $c): bool
{
    return $r >= 0 && $r < count($grid) && $c >= 0 && $c < count($grid[$r]);
}

function neighbors(int $r, int $c): array
{
    return array(
        array($r - 1, $c),
        array($r, $c + 1),
        array($r + 1, $c),
        array($r, $c - 1),
    );
}

function buildPath(array $parents, array $start, array $end): array
{
    $path = array($end);
    $cur = $end;
    while ($cur !== $start) {
        $cur = $parents[$cur[0] . ',' . $cur[1]];
        $path[] = $cur;
    }
    return array_reverse($path);
}

function maze(array $grid): array
{
    if (count($grid) === 0 || count($grid[0]) === 0) {
        return array();
    }
    $lastRow = count($grid) - 1;
    $lastCol = count($grid[$lastRow]) - 1;
    if ($grid[0][0] !== 0 || $grid[$lastRow][$lastCol] !== 0) {
        return array();

            return buildPath($parents, $start, array($r, $c));
        }
        foreach (neighbors($r, $c) as [$nr, $nc]) {
            if (!inBounds($grid, $nr, $nc) || $grid[$nr][$nc] !== 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $next = array($nr, $nc);
            if (in_array($next, $visited, true)) {
                continue;
            }
            $visited[] = $next;
            $parents[$nr . ',' . $nc] = array($r, $c);
            $queue[] = $next;

text_es: Given a string of digits, return a list of strings representing the digits drawn with ascii characters. Use a predefined map where each digit from zero to nine is defined as a list of three strings representing the top, middle, and bottom rows of the seven-segment display. For example, zero is formed by an underscore for the top, and pipes and underscores for the sides and bottom. Concatenate the rows of the digits to form three final strings that represent the whole number side-by-side. Example: input a string containing one and two, output a list of three strings representing the assembled ascii art. Entry function is `segment(digits)`.
text_nat:
<?php

function digitPatterns(): array
{
    return [
        '0' => [' _ ', '| |', '|_|'],
        '1' => ['   ', '  |', '  |'],
        '2' => [' _ ', ' _|', '|_ '],
        '3' => [' _ ', ' _|', ' _|'],
        '4' => ['   ', '|_|', '  |'],
        '5' => [' _ ', '|_ ', ' _|'],
        '6' => [' _ ', '|_ ', '|_|'],
        '7' => [' _ ', '  |', '  |'],
        '8' => [' _ ', '|_|', '|_|'],
        '9' => [' _ ', '|_|', ' _|'],
    ];
}

function segment(string $digits): array
{
    $patterns = digitPatterns();
    $rows = ['', '', ''];
    foreach (str_split($digits) as $char) {
        if (!isset($patterns[$char])) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("'$char' is not a decimal digit");
        }
        foreach ($patterns[$char] as $index => $part) {
            $rows[$index] .= $part;
        }
    }
    return $rows;
}

function segmentWrapped(string $digits, int $perLine): array
{
    if ($perLine < 1) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('perLine must be positive');
    }
    if ($digits === '') {
        return [];
    }
    $blocks = [];
    foreach (str_split($digits, $perLine) as $chunk) {
        $blocks[] = segment($chunk);
    }
    return $blocks;
}

function frame(array $rows): array
{
    $width = max(array_map('strlen', $rows));
    $border = '+' . str_repeat('-', $width + 2) . '+';
    $framed = [$border];
    foreach ($rows as $row) {
        $framed[] = '| ' . str_pad($row, $width) . ' |';
    }
    $framed[] = $border;
    return $framed;
}

function printBlock(array $rows): void
{
    foreach (frame($rows) as $line) {
        echo $line, PHP_EOL;
    }
}

    printBlock(segment($number));
}

text_es: Convert an English word into a simplified Braille representation. Define a dictionary for the first ten letters of the alphabet where each letter maps to a grid of dots and spaces. The grid for each letter should be defined as a list of three strings, each containing two characters which are either a capital O for a raised dot or a period for a flat space. The function receives a string of lowercase letters and should return a list of three strings, joining the grids of each character horizontally with a single space between them. Ignore characters not in the first ten letters. Example: input the string cab, output a list of three strings representing the Braille rows. Entry function is `braille(word)`.
text_nat:
<?php

function brailleMap(): array
{
    return [
        'a' => ['O.', '..', '..'],
        'b' => ['O.', 'O.', '..'],
        'c' => ['OO', '..', '..'],
        'd' => ['OO', '.O', '..'],
        'e' => ['O.', '.O', '..'],
        'f' => ['OO', 'O.', '..'],
        'g' => ['OO', 'OO', '..'],
        'h' => ['O.', 'OO', '..'],
        'i' => ['.O', 'O.', '..'],
        'j' => ['.O', 'OO', '..'],
    ];
}

function braille(string $word): array
{
    $map = brailleMap();
    $cells = [];
    foreach (str_split(strtolower($word)) as $char) {
        if (isset($map[$char])) {
            $cells[] = $map[$char];
        }
    }
    $rows = ['', '', ''];
    foreach (array_keys($rows) as $line) {
        $pieces = [];
        foreach ($cells as $cell) {
            $pieces[] = $cell[$line];
        }
        $rows[$line] = implode(' ', $pieces);
    }
    return $rows;
}

function ignoredCharacters(string $word): array
{
    $map = brailleMap();
    $ignored = [];
    foreach (str_split(strtolower($word)) as $char) {
        if (!isset($map[$char])) {
            $ignored[] = $char;
        }
    }
    return array_values(array_unique($ignored));
}

function describe(string $word): string
{
    $lines = ['Word: ' . $word];
    foreach (braille($word) as $row) {
        $lines[] = '  ' . $row;
    }
    $ignored = ignoredCharacters($word);
    if ($ignored !== []) {
        $lines[] = '  (ignored: ' . implode(', ', $ignored) . ')';
    }
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

text_es: Calculate the total molecular mass of a chemical compound given a list of element names. Build an internal reference table for at least eight common elements like hydrogen, helium, lithium, beryllium, boron, carbon, nitrogen, and oxygen. Store the properties for each element as a list containing its chemical symbol, atomic number, and standard atomic weight. When a list of element names is provided, look up each name in the reference table, extract its atomic weight, and sum them to produce the final mass. If an element is unknown, add zero. Example: input a list of hydrogen, oxygen, hydrogen, output the sum of their masses which is approximately eighteen. Entry function is `chemistry(elements)`.
text_nat:
<?php

function elementTable()
{
    return [
        'hydrogen'  => ['H',  1, 1.008],
        'helium'    => ['He', 2, 4.002602],
        'lithium'   => ['Li', 3, 6.94],
        'beryllium' => ['Be', 4, 9.0121831],
        'boron'     => ['B',  5, 10.81],
        'carbon'    => ['C',  6, 12.011],
        'nitrogen'  => ['N',  7, 14.007],
        'oxygen'    => ['O',  8, 15.999],
    ];
}

function atomicWeight($name)
{
    $table = elementTable();
    $key = strtolower(trim($name));
    if (!isset($table[$key])) {
        return 0.0;
    }
    return $table[$key][2];
}

function chemistry($elements)
{
    $total = 0.0;
    foreach ($elements as $name) {
        $total += atomicWeight($name);
    }
    return $total;
}

function formula($elements)
{
    $table = elementTable();
    $counts = [];
    foreach ($elements as $name) {
        $key = strtolower(trim($name));
        $symbol = isset($table[$key]) ? $table[$key][0] : '?';
        $counts[$symbol] = ($counts[$symbol] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    $parts = [];
    foreach ($counts as $symbol => $n) {
        $parts[] = $n > 1 ? $symbol . $n : $symbol;
    }
    return implode('', $parts);
}

function report($elements)
{
    return sprintf('%-8s %d atoms  %10.4f u', formula($elements), count($elements), chemistry($elements));
}

$compounds = [
    'water'          => ['hydrogen', 'oxygen', 'hydrogen'],
    'carbon dioxide' => ['carbon', 'oxygen', 'oxygen'],
    'ammonia'        => ['nitrogen', 'hydrogen', 'hydrogen', 'hydrogen'],
    'borane'         => ['boron', 'hydrogen', 'hydrogen', 'hydrogen'],
    'mystery gas'    => ['helium', 'unobtainium'],
];

foreach ($compounds as $label => $atoms) {
    printf("%-15s %s\n", $label, report($atoms));
}

$metals = ['lithium', 'beryllium'];
printf("%-15s %s\n", 'alloy sample', report($metals));

text_es: Implement a deterministic finite automaton that validates whether a sequence of inputs matches a specific pattern. Define the transition table as a collection of states, where each state contains a mapping of possible input strings to the next state number. Include at least eight distinct states in the transition table to handle the various stages of the input sequence. Start at state zero and process each input sequentially. Return true if the final state is an accepting state, and false otherwise. Example: input a list of words like letter, at, letter, dot, letter, output true. Entry function is `simulate(inputs)`.
text_nat:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Deterministic finite automaton that recognises simple e-mail shapes:
 * letters, an "at", a dotted domain with at least two labels.
 */
function transitionTable(): array
{
    return [
        ['letter' => 1],
        ['letter' => 1, 'dot' => 7, 'at' => 2],
        ['letter' => 3],
        ['letter' => 3, 'dot' => 4, 'dash' => 6],
        ['letter' => 5],
        ['letter' => 5, 'dot' => 4],
        ['letter' => 3],
        ['letter' => 1],
    ];
}

function acceptingStates(): array
{
    return [5];
}

function tokenMap(): array
{
    return ['@' => 'at', '.' => 'dot', '-' => 'dash'];
}

function tokenize(string $text): array
{
    $map = tokenMap();
    $tokens = [];
    foreach (preg_split('//u', $text, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY) as $char) {
        if (ctype_alpha($char)) {
            $tokens[] = 'letter';
        } elseif (isset($map[$char])) {
            $tokens[] = $map[$char];
        } else {
            $tokens[] = 'invalid';
        }
    }
    return $tokens;
}

function simulate(array $inputs): bool
{
    $table = transitionTable();
    $state = 0;
    foreach ($inputs as $input) {
        if (!isset($table[$state][$input])) {
            return false;
        }
        $state = $table[$state][$input];
    }
    return in_array($state, acceptingStates(), true);
}

function report(string $text): string
{
    $verdict = simulate(tokenize($text)) ? 'accepted' : 'rejected';
    return str_pad($text, 26) . $verdict;
}

$sequences = [
    ['letter', 'at', 'letter', 'dot', 'letter'],
    ['letter', 'letter', 'at', 'letter'],
    ['letter', 'at', 'letter', 'dash', 'letter', 'dot', 'letter', 'letter'],
];
foreach ($sequences as $sequence) {
    echo implode(' ', $sequence), ' -> ', var_export(simulate($sequence), true), PHP_EOL;
}

$samples = [
    'user@example.com',
    'first.last@mail.co.uk',
    'bad@@host.com',
    'nodomain@host',
    'dash@my-host.net',
    'spaced name@host.org',
];
foreach ($samples as $sample) {
    echo report($sample), PHP_EOL;
}

<?php

text_es: Determine if a given three-by-three grid of numbers is a magic square, meaning all rows, columns, and the two main diagonals sum to the same value. Define the eight standard lines to check as a list of eight paths, where each path is itself a list of three coordinates given as row and column index pairs. Iterate over these predefined coordinate paths to extract the values from the grid and compute their sums. If all eight sums are equal and the grid uses all numbers from one to nine exactly once, return true. Otherwise, return false. Example: input a valid magic square grid of integers, output true. Entry function is `magic(grid)`.
text_nat:
<?php

function linePaths(): array
{
    $paths = [];
    for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) {
        $row = [];
        $col = [];
        for ($j = 0; $j < 3; $j++) {
            $row[] = [$i, $j];
            $col[] = [$j, $i];
        }
        $paths[] = $row;
        $paths[] = $col;
    }
    $down = [];
    $up = [];
    for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) {
        $down[] = [$i, $i];
        $up[] = [$i, 2 - $i];
    }
    $paths[] = $down;
    $paths[] = $up;
    return $paths;
}

function pathSums(array $grid, array $paths): array
{
    $sums = [];
    foreach ($paths as $path) {
        $total = 0;
        foreach ($path as $cell) {
            $total += $grid[$cell[0]][$cell[1]];
        }
        $sums[] = $total;
    }
    return $sums;
}

function isThreeByThree($grid): bool
{
    if (!is_array($grid) || count($grid) !== 3) {
        return false;
    }
    foreach ($grid as $row) {
        if (!is_array($row) || count($row) !== 3) {
            return false;
        }
        foreach ($row as $value) {
            if (!is_int($value)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

function usesOneToNine(array $grid): bool
{
    $flat = [];
    foreach ($grid as $row) {
        foreach ($row as $value) {
            $flat[] = $value;
        }
    }
    sort($flat);
    return $flat === range(1, 9);
}

function magic($grid): bool
{
    if (!isThreeByThree($grid)) {
        return false;
    }
    $sums = pathSums($grid, linePaths());
    return count(array_unique($sums)) === 1 && usesOneToNine($grid);
}

function formatGrid(array $grid): string
{
    $rows = [];
    foreach ($grid as $row) {
        $cells = [];
        foreach ($row as $value) {
            $cells[] = str_pad((string)$value, 2, ' ', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        }
        $rows[] = implode(' ', $cells);
    }
    return implode(' | ', $rows);
}

$squares = [];
$squares['lo shu'] = [
    [2, 7, 6],
    [9, 5, 1],
    [4, 3, 8],
];
$squares['rotated'] = [
    [4, 9, 2],
    [3, 5, 7],
    [8, 1, 6],
];
$squares['equal sums, repeats'] = [
    [5, 5, 5],
    [5, 5, 5],
    [5, 5, 5],
];
$squares['sequential'] = [
    [1, 2, 3],
    [4, 5, 6],
    [7, 8, 9],
];

foreach ($squares as $label => $grid) {
    $verdict = magic($grid) ? 'true' : 'false';
    echo str_pad($label, 22), formatGrid($grid), ' -> ', $verdict, PHP_EOL;
}

text_es: Simulate a simplified model of our solar system for a given number of time steps. Initialize the system state with the eight major planets. Each planet should be stored as a list holding its current distance from the sun, orbital speed, and mass. For each time step, update the distance of each planet by adding its speed. After running the simulation for the specified time, return a list containing the final distances of all eight planets. Example: input a time step of ten, output the updated distances for the planets. Entry function is `gravity(time)`.
text_nat:
<?php

function initSolarSystem()
{
    $mercury = [57.9, 47.4, 3.30e23];
    $venus   = [108.2, 35.0, 4.87e24];
    $earth   = [149.6, 29.8, 5.97e24];
    $mars    = [227.9, 24.1, 6.42e23];
    $jupiter = [778.6, 13.1, 1.898e27];
    $saturn  = [1433.5, 9.7, 5.68e26];
    $uranus  = [2872.5, 6.8, 8.68e25];
    $neptune = [4495.1, 5.4, 1.02e26];

    return [$mercury, $venus, $earth, $mars, $jupiter, $saturn, $uranus, $neptune];
}

function planetNames()
{
    return ['Mercury', 'Venus', 'Earth', 'Mars', 'Jupiter', 'Saturn', 'Uranus', 'Neptune'];
}

function advance($system)
{
    $next = [];
    foreach ($system as $planet) {
        list($distance, $speed, $mass) = $planet;
        $next[] = [$distance + $speed, $speed, $mass];
    }
    return $next;
}

function distances($system)
{
    $out = [];
    foreach ($system as $planet) {
        $out[] = $planet[0];
    }
    return $out;
}

function gravity($time)
{
    if (!is_numeric($time) || $time < 0) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('time must be a non-negative number');
    }
    $system = initSolarSystem();
    for ($step = 0; $step < (int)$time; $step++) {
        $system = advance($system);
    }
    return distances($system);
}

function formatReport($finalDistances)
{
    $names = planetNames();
    $lines = [];
    foreach ($finalDistances as $index => $distance) {
        $lines[] = sprintf('%-8s %12.1f', $names[$index], $distance);
    }
    return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
}

$runs = [0, 10, 100];
foreach ($runs as $time) {
    echo 'After ' . $time . ' time steps (million km):' . PHP_EOL;
    echo formatReport(gravity($time)) . PHP_EOL . PHP_EOL;
}

print_r(gravity(10));

text_es: Generate a list of colors for a user interface based on a requested theme name. Store a predefined collection of themes such as ocean, forest, sunset, volcano, midnight, desert, tundra, and twilight. Each theme must be defined as a list of three distinct colors, and each color should be represented as a list of three integers for the red, green, and blue channels. Look up the requested theme and return its colors. If the theme is not found, return a default grayscale theme. Example: input the string ocean, output a list of three color lists. Entry function is `palette(theme)`.

<?php

    return [

        ],
        'sunset' => [
            [120, 34, 62],

        'volcano' => [

        ],
        'midnight' => [
            [8, 12, 36],
            [40, 54, 118],
            [148, 163, 224],
        ],
        'desert' => [
            [122, 88, 48],
            [206, 164, 96],
            [244, 226, 186],
        ],
        'tundra' => [

        ],
        'twilight' => [
            [45, 27, 78],
            [108, 74, 160],

function palette($theme): array
{
    $key = strtolower(trim((string) $theme));

        [128, 128, 128],

{
    return sprintf('#%02X%02X%02X', $color[0], $color[1], $color[2]);

{
    $weights = [0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722];

}
